notes.title: Phantasma is out on Steam !
notes.content:
In order to fund my bigger projects like SteamDolls, I had to do a "much simpler" game, it's called Phantasma. In this game, you will find Puzzles, Madness and Bunnies ! If you want to support my work please take a look at the store page.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/608870/Phantasma_VR/

Thanks a lot !

notes.title: SteamDolls Demo updated with trackpad movement, tutorial and quick inventory !
notes.content:
The title does a pretty good job to describe what this updated demo is about.

-Trackpad movement Onward style (switch between this and teleport with the grip button on the left controller).

-Tutorial at the beginning of the demo.

-Quick Inventory, you will never be stuck again by loosing a quest item to the dreaded floor.

-Slightly rotated hands for added realism.

-Loot is kind of shiny now.

-New mechanics for grabbing and you can make a fist by keeping the trigger pressed.

-A lot more but I don't remember every improvements ;)
